label: High loneliness, depression, and anxiety profile
summary: Respondents in this profile report elevated loneliness along with comparatively high depressive and anxiety symptoms. The pattern suggests notable emotional distress across social, mood, and anxiety-related indicators.
demographic_anchor: More likely to be female, hold a graduate degree or higher, and report more than 5 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Higher average depressive symptom score (PHQ-9 mean: 1.75)
Higher average anxiety symptom score (GAD-7 mean: 2.17)
Represents 165 respondents in the training split
tone: Distressed, socially disconnected, and emotionally strained
